messages:
maria (AE): Quick sync on Acme POC — they signed the SOW pending a short scoping call. Need alignment on success criteria, timeline, and whether we run this on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private (EU region required).

maria (AE): Key asks from customer: EU data residency, PII redaction evaluation, 95th perc latency target ~250ms (ideally <200ms), and an integration demo with their prompt set (50k tokens/week). They also asked for a price ballpark for Dedicated vs Hosted for this volume.

rachel_acme (Acme): Confirming — yes EU-only. We also need audit logs and KMS integration. Timeline: 4 weeks for POC, must be complete before end of quarter.

jon (solutions): Ok — propose a 4-week plan: week 0: infra + creds; week 1: run initial evals (latency + quality) on sample prompts; week 2: iterate prompts/quantization; week 3: scale load tests; week 4: joint review and handoff. Success criteria draft: 1) p95 latency <= 250ms for 512-token prompts at our test QPS, 2) automated eval pass rate >= 85% vs their rubric, 3) no critical security findings in questionnaire, 4) integration demo with embedding similarity >= 0.75.

alex (eng): For deployment mode decision: quick summary — Hosted gives fastest time-to-value (we can spin EU-hosted instance and run within 24–48h), Dedicated gives predictable throughput and SLA (reserved GPU pool) — useful if they need consistent p95 at scale, Private (VPC/on-prem) needed if their policy forbids any managed plane or requires full air-gapped on-prem, but has lead time (2–6 weeks depending on network/compliance).

sam (security): Notes on the questionnaire: Acme requires KMS in eu-west-1, audit log retention 12 months, SOC2 + encryption-in-transit+at-rest. Hosted can meet those with our EU region + customer-managed KMS (we'll need their key ARN). Dedicated also supports KMS and private networking. Private is the only one that fully isolates control plane. We'll need their answers for: data classification, acceptable vendor list, and whether they require HSM-backed keys.

rachel_acme (Acme): We prefer minimal ops overhead. Hosted is fine if you can guarantee EU data residency and KMS. Dedicated would be fine if pricing looks sensible. Private is last resort.

maria (AE): Action items: 1) Jon + Alex to produce quick Bench + Sizing note for Hosted vs Dedicated (include expected p95 latency at 5 QPS, cost estimate for 1 month and for annual commit); 2) Sam to flag any blocker items in the security questionnaire that would push them to Private; 3) I'll share a diffable prompt set (approx 300 examples) and their eval rubric by EOD.

jon (solutions): Will do. For sizing I need: target QPS (rachel said 5), typical max seq length (512?), and eval throughput target. Alex — can you include quantized model variants in the comparisons?

alex (eng): Yup — include 16-bit and 4-bit quantized flavors and a fallback larger model. I'll include expected token/sec and p95 numbers based on our EU kernel profiles. Preliminary numbers: Hosted eu-west-1 with batching should hit ~180–220ms p95 at 5 QPS for a 7B quantized model; Dedicated with pinned GPUs can shave another ~30–50ms and reduce variance.

sam (security): I reviewed their questionnaire stub. Two potential blockers: 1) They require HSM-backed keys by default — we support customer-managed KMS but HSM requirement could push to Private unless their cloud KMS is acceptable. 2) Network egress restrictions: if they require no internet egress, Hosted will fail — Dedicated with VPC peering or Private would be needed. I'll annotate exact questions and where Hosted/Dedicated meet them.

maria (AE): Rachel — can you confirm whether Acme's KMS requirement accepts cloud KMS (AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys) or is strictly on-prem HSM? Also confirm egress policy.

rachel_acme (Acme): We use AWS KMS with CloudHSM backing in our account; that should be fine. Egress: internal services allowed to call external endpoints only within EU; no cross-region egress.

jon (solutions): Good — that means Hosted in eu-west-1 with customer-managed KMS is viable. We should still present Dedicated as an option if they want guaranteed isolation and SLAs.

maria (AE): Pricing ask: Rachel asked for a short Hosted vs Dedicated estimate. Jon/Alex — please include a 1-month proof-of-concept estimate and a 12-month reserved commit estimate (if Dedicated) so procurement can size it. Also call out any setup fees for Private.

alex (eng): I'll draft numbers. Quick note on deployment snippet for Hosted EU with KMS (for ops):

```
region: eu-west-1
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  model: redwood-7b-quant
  kms_key: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
  batch_config:
    max_tokens: 1024
    max_batch_delay_ms: 10
```

alex (eng): If they pick Dedicated we'll recommend a 1-GPU baseline with autoscale to 2 during load tests; for 5 QPS 7B quant model that's cost-effective.

sam (security): I'll produce a short table of questionnaire items with "meets/partial/needs work" for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. That should make the decision clear for procurement.

maria (AE): Timeline: can the infra + initial Hosted run be ready in 48–72h after we get their KMS ARN and sample prompts?

jon (solutions): Yes — if we have credentials and the sample set by EOD tomorrow we can run initial evals within 48h. Dedicated spins up slower (couple of business days for capacity allocation + network peering). Private needs a formal request with networking/ops and is slower.

rachel_acme (Acme): We'll share KMS ARN and sample prompts today. Thanks — prefer Hosted if SLAs are reasonable.

maria (AE): Perfect. I'll follow up with a short email summarizing the plan and owners. Jon/Alex/Sam — please drop your deliverables in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

jon (solutions): Uploading sizing note shortly.

alex (eng): Draft cost + perf numbers coming in next message.

sam (security): Questionnaire pass/fail table eta EOD tomorrow.
